findings.issue: Reactions re-fetched for all messages on every messages array change
findings.impact: Wasteful network requests when message list updates, causing unnecessary load
findings.fix: Cache reactions per message and only fetch for new message IDs via incremental update

findings.issue: Tablet breakpoint (768-1024px) sidebar auto-collapse not fully tested across all tablet sizes
findings.impact: Tablet users may encounter inconsistent sidebar behavior at edge breakpoints
findings.fix: Verify sidebar collapse/expand behavior across all tablet sizes and orientations

findings.issue: renderPreview uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML with DOMPurify sanitization — acceptable but should be migrated to a safer markdown renderer long-term
findings.impact: Low residual XSS risk if DOMPurify configuration is not comprehensive
findings.fix: Migrate to a dedicated React markdown component (e.g., react-markdown) with proper plugin support
